acceptance: Reproduce first: a publish dry-run to a local destination copies a legacy text companion and SQL raw_explain_output with synthetic paths byte-for-byte.

publish sanitizes each companion with the export anonymizer, re-scans with the shared detector, and publishes only when clean; on any residual leak it publishes nothing for that run and prints a redacted diagnostic naming file and field only.
Fail closed and atomic: no partial publication when one companion fails; safe, errors-only and missing companions pass through unchanged.
Private raw export tests stay green unchanged; a real local-destination publish dry-run is recorded in the PR body, with no upload or deletion of hosted data.
context:
Publisher bypass and SQL behavior reported by publication batch leader; reproduce at current head before implementing. New hosted data removal or production publication needs separate approval.

DECISIONS (owner, 2026-11-08): detector = known local roots (/Users, /home, /tmp, /var/folders, /private, /mnt, /opt, any Windows drive letter, UNC) PLUS the run's configured data and output directories, with an exact-rule placeholder allowlist (<redacted> and bare /data-style neutral placeholders); NOT every absolute path. Publish boundary = sanitize with the export anonymizer, re-scan, publish only if clean, otherwise reject with a redacted diagnostic and publish nothing (fail closed). ORDER: after the detector item; reuse the export sanitizer from the export item rather than a second sanitizer. GUARDRAILS: stored fingerprints are never recomputed or altered by sanitizing text; plan structure, errors, fingerprint_varied/fingerprint_variants and keys are preserved; never mutate inputs in place; diagnostics must not print the leaked path values; no hosted data deletion, republish or history rewrite; private (non-anonymized) local exports keep their current behavior; false positives are bounded by an allowlist test that real plan text (catalog names, URLs, relative table tails, Spark/LakeSail scans) is not flagged. Verification rubric: (1) reproduce the defect with a failing test or script before editing; (2) focused suites pass via uv run -- python -m pytest -n 0; (3) make comment-policy-check and ruff on touched files; (4) the runtime smoke named in acceptance is recorded in the PR body; (5) one final batch PR merges with green CI and a passing oracle review.
description: Publication investigation reported benchbox publish run copies companion files byte-for-byte without a path check. Capture-time cleanup cannot protect older or externally produced companions. SQL plans also retain local paths in raw_explain_output when exported without anonymization; a test currently treats that private-export behavior as intentional. The public boundary must not mistake such files for publication-safe artifacts.
